semiconductor_relevance: High — GIGALANE specializes in high technology plasma etching equipment for semiconductor and MEMS applications.
summary: GIGALANE's Equipment Business Unit has been at the forefront of developing advanced plasma etching technologies since 2000, focusing on applications in the semiconductor and MEMS sectors. Their notable products include LED PSS and GaN etchers, which are utilized in mass production environments.
